onChange.script:
if self.params.value.has_key('imageId'):
		imageData = system.kanoa.quality.image.getImageData({'imageId': self.params.value.imageId or -1, 'includeThumbnail': True})
		imageData = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(imageData, 0)
		imageData['filePath'] = None
		if imageData['imageDescription'] is None: imageData['imageDescription'] = '' 
		if imageData['imageName'] is None: imageData['imageName'] = '' 
		if imageData['imageType'] is None: imageData['imageType'] = '' 
		self.custom.imageData = imageData
	
	if self.custom.imageData['imageId'] is None and self.params.value.has_key('imageType'):
		self.custom.imageData.imageType = self.params.value.imageType or ''
	
	return

config.script:
self.view.custom.gettingImage = True
	
	import base64
	self.view.custom.imageData.image = base64.b64encode(event.file.getBytes())
	self.view.custom.imageData.imageName = event.file.name
	
	filePath = 'C:\\kanoaImages\%s'% event.file.name
	system.kanoa.file.deleteFile(filePath)
	
	log = system.util.getLogger("kanoaImage")
	log.info("Creating  %s"%filePath)
	
	event.file.copyTo(filePath) #We'll store this file on the gateway so we can convert and create thumbnails
	self.view.custom.imageData.filePath = filePath	
	
	self.view.custom.gettingImage = False
	
	imageData = self.view.custom.imageData
	chkItemId = self.view.params.value.chkItemId if self.view.params.value.has_key('chkItemId') else None
	imageId = self.view.params.value.imageId if self.view.params.value.has_key('imageId') else None
		
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("filePath %s, chkItemId %s, imageId %s, imageName %s, imageType %s, imageDescription %s, userId %s"%(imageData['filePath'], chkItemId, imageId, imageData['imageName'], imageData['imageType'], imageData['imageDescription'] or None, userId))
	
	imageId, msg = system.kanoa.quality.image.processImage(imageData['filePath'], chkItemId, imageId, imageData['imageName'], imageData['imageType'], imageData['imageDescription'] or None, userId)
	
	if msg:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': msg})
		return

	self.view.params.value.imageId = imageId
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Image Added'})		

	if self.view.params.value.has_key('chkItemId') and self.view.params.value.chkItemId:
		payload = {'chkItemId': chkItemId, 'value': imageData['imageName']}
		system.perspective.print("Sending 'ValuePicked' message with %s"%payload)
		log.info("Sending 'ValuePicked' message with %s"%payload)
		system.perspective.sendMessage("ValuePicked", payload)
		
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshImages', {})	#Tell calling screen to update itself to show the new image
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshImage', {'imageId': imageId})
	
	return
